#!/bin/bash
# MU-ADOPT-HROOT 10-19: host-root endpoint / epoch allocator / KV layer programme for 4 users.  Verilator 5.050 (the
# closure daemon's version).  usage: run_mu_hroot.sh ROOT OUT CASE
#   MU 1 PASS : tb_mu_hroot_e2e | tb_mu_hroot_collide (negative control, must report the collision fault) |
#               tb_mu_lprg_lockstep (MU 0 == original; MU 1 user 0 gap 0 == original) | tb_mu_lprg_lockstep_s2 |
#               lint_guard_mu (the MU 1 qkd_hr_core_guard with its member sources)
#   MU 0 ident: ex_endpoint (existing bench, original) | ex_endpoint_mu0 (same bench, endpoint -> _mu #(MU 0)) |
#               ex_lifecycle (existing bench) | ex_lifecycle_mu0 (lifecycle binds the allocator _mu #(MU 0))
#   mutants (must FAIL): ep1 ep2 al1 al2 kp1 kp2 kp3
# Every file a case reads is in lists/<tb>.f.
set -u
ROOT=$(cd "${1:?root}" && pwd); OUT=${2:?out}; CASE=${3:?case}
V=${VERILATOR:-$HOME/.local/opentallas-tools/verilator-5.050/bin/verilator}
L=$(dirname "$(readlink -f "$0")")/lists
mkdir -p "$OUT"; OUT=$(cd "$OUT" && pwd)
M=rtl/qwen_sys/mu_qwen_20261018
EP=$M/qkd_host_native_token_endpoint_cancel_mu.sv; AL=$M/ot_qwen_tp8_token_epoch_allocator_mu.sv
KP=$M/qkd_static_kv_layer_programme_mu.sv
TB=$CASE; MF=""; FROM=""; TO=""; PA=""; TOP=""
case "$CASE" in
 tb_mu_hroot_collide) TB=tb_mu_hroot_e2e; PA=+COLLIDE;;
 tb_mu_lprg_lockstep_s2) TB=tb_mu_lprg_lockstep; PA=+SEED=1234;;
 ex_endpoint) TB=tb_qkd_host_native_token_endpoint_cancel;;
 ex_endpoint_mu0) TB=tb_qkd_host_native_token_endpoint_cancel; MF=rtl/test/qwen_host/tb_qkd_host_native_token_endpoint_cancel.sv
   FROM='qkd_host_native_token_endpoint_cancel #(.ENABLE_NATIVE(1),.MUT(MUT))d'; TO='qkd_host_native_token_endpoint_cancel_mu #(.ENABLE_NATIVE(1),.MUT(MUT),.MU(0))d';;
 ex_lifecycle) TB=tb_qkd_host_lifecycle_collected;;
 ex_lifecycle_mu0) TB=tb_qkd_host_lifecycle_collected; MF=rtl/qwen_sys/host_integrated_20261014/qkd_host_lifecycle_collected.sv
   FROM='ot_qwen_tp8_token_epoch_allocator #(.INITIAL_EPOCH(INITIAL_EPOCH)) allocator'; TO='ot_qwen_tp8_token_epoch_allocator_mu #(.INITIAL_EPOCH(INITIAL_EPOCH),.MU(0)) allocator';;
 # endpoint keeps the single-user position check (pos[17:13] == 0): users 1..3 are protocol faults
 ep1) TB=tb_mu_hroot_e2e; MF=$EP; FROM='hc_q[15:13]==0'; TO='hc_q[17:13]==0';;
 # endpoint retire waits for the global drains although other users are in flight
 ep2) TB=tb_mu_hroot_e2e; MF=$EP; FROM='(MUT==1||drains||!alone)'; TO='(MUT==1||drains)';;
 # allocator epoch without the user in its low bits
 al1) TB=tb_mu_hroot_e2e; MF=$AL; FROM='g_epoch <= {seq[ureq], ureq};'; TO='g_epoch <= {seq[ureq], 2'"'"'b00};';;
 # allocator single-busy (one allocation for all users, as the original)
 al2) TB=tb_mu_hroot_e2e; MF=$AL; FROM='!ubusy[ureq] && !grant_pending'; TO='!(|ubusy) && !grant_pending';;
 # KV programme: user not taken from the epoch (every start lands in context 0)
 kp1) TB=tb_mu_hroot_e2e; MF=$KP; FROM="wire[1:0]us=epoch_q[1:0];"; TO="wire[1:0]us=2'd0;";;
 # KV programme: metadata follow the previous owner, not the firing context
 kp2) TB=tb_mu_hroot_e2e; MF=$KP; FROM='epoch<=(start_q&&start_ok&&fire_u==us)?epoch_q:c_epoch[fire_u];'; TO='epoch<=(start_q&&start_ok&&fire_u==us)?epoch_q:c_epoch[owner];';;
 # KV programme: collision detection removed (collide case must then FAIL)
 kp3) TB=tb_mu_hroot_e2e; PA=+COLLIDE; MF=$KP; FROM='wire collide=(e_any&(e_any-4'"'"'d1))!=0;'; TO="wire collide=1'b0;";;
esac
[ -f "$L/$TB.f" ] || { echo "MU_HROOT $CASE: no list $TB"; exit 2; }
W="$OUT/src_$CASE"; rm -rf "$W"; mkdir -p "$W"
while read -r f; do mkdir -p "$W/$(dirname "$f")"; cp "$ROOT/$f" "$W/$f"; done < "$L/$TB.f"
if [ -n "$MF" ]; then
  python3 - "$W/$MF" "$FROM" "$TO" <<'PY' || { echo "MU_HROOT $CASE: mutation did not apply"; exit 2; }
import sys
p, a, b = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
s = open(p).read()
assert s.count(a) == 1, (a, s.count(a))
open(p, "w").write(s.replace(a, b))
PY
fi
cd "$W"
if [ "$TB" = lint_guard_mu ]; then
  "$V" --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-UNOPTFLAT -Wno-WIDTH --top-module qkd_hr_core_guard \
    $(cat "$L/$TB.f") > "$OUT/$CASE.log" 2>&1; rc=$?
  if [ $rc = 0 ] && ! grep -qE '%Error|PINMISSING|PINNOTFOUND|PINCONNECTEMPTY' "$OUT/$CASE.log" \
     && grep -q 'qkd_host_native_token_endpoint_cancel_mu' "$L/$TB.f"; then
    echo "PASS LINT_GUARD_MU qkd_hr_core_guard (u_rank__u_native = qkd_host_native_token_endpoint_cancel_mu, MU 1)" >> "$OUT/$CASE.log"
  else echo "FAIL LINT_GUARD_MU rc=$rc" >> "$OUT/$CASE.log"; fi
  echo "MU_HROOT $CASE: $(tail -1 "$OUT/$CASE.log")"; grep -q '^PASS' "$OUT/$CASE.log"; exit
fi
"$V" --binary --timing -O2 -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-UNOPTFLAT -Wno-WIDTH \
  --top-module "$TB" -Mdir obj -j ${VJ:-4} -o sim $(cat "$L/$TB.f") > "$OUT/$CASE.build" 2>&1 \
  || { echo "MU_HROOT $CASE: BUILD-ERR"; tail -20 "$OUT/$CASE.build"; exit 1; }
./obj/sim $PA > "$OUT/$CASE.log" 2>&1; rc=$?
r=$(grep -E '^(PASS|FAIL)|^%Error|Fatal|fatal' "$OUT/$CASE.log" | tail -1)
echo "MU_HROOT $CASE rc=$rc: $r"
rm -rf "$W/obj"

"""Q-DV slice2 benches (rtl/qwen_dv/qfd_dv_slice2.sv, dv2r8f2 port cut) on tb_qfd_dv2.sv: the step-1/2 benches
(a .. g, same goldens and checks as dv_bench.py) carried over to the chain ports, plus (h) the SETID enumeration of a
12-slice chain.  Differences from dv_bench.py are only in how stimulus reaches a slice:
  commands   on s0.cmd_i with dst = slice, injected 2 edges earlier per hop (cmd chain: 2 edges a hop);
             a SETID (id 0) opens every run
  x loads    AR-return words on s0.ch_dn_i (they climb the return chain); PORTS ar_en arms only the target slice
  rs words   rs_s / rs_n per slice: both level-7 pairs in parallel (lower pair on rs_s, upper on rs_n)
  outputs    every AR / D2D word leaves at the W5 edge (s0.ch_dn_o); scalar words are 48 b (converted here)

    python3 rtl/test/qwen_dv/dv_bench2.py [a .. h] [--mut N] [--work DIR]
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import os
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))
import dv_bench as B  # noqa: E402

G, F, EPS = B.G, B.F, B.EPS
ROOT = B.ROOT
SRCS2 = [s for s in B.SRCS if not s.endswith(("qfd_dv_slice.sv", "qfd_dv_redstn.sv", "qfd_dv_scalar.sv",
                                                "tb_qfd_dv.sv"))] + \
    ["rtl/qwen_dv/qfd_dv_slice2.sv", "rtl/qwen_dv/qfd_dv_redstn2.sv", "rtl/qwen_dv/qfd_dv_scalar2.sv",
     "rtl/test/qwen_dv/tb_qfd_dv2.sv", "rtl/qwen_dv/mu/qfd_dv_amax_mu.sv", "rtl/qwen_dv/qfd_dv_slice2_faces.sv"]
# MU-ADOPT-SLICE 10-19 (environment, default = today): DV2_MU_NU users of the LM-head argmax (qfd_dv_slice2 MU_NU);
# DV2_FACE 0 master qfd_dv_slice2 / 1 qfd_dv_slice2_w / 2 qfd_dv_slice2_e (tb_dv2_slice port map); DV2_AM_MUT bench-only
# qfd_dv_amax_mu mutant (+define+OT_DV_AMAX_MUT); DV2_GAP edges between an STN op's last data word and the next op (m).
# MU-DQ-SLICEKC 10-19 (merge of MU-SLICE-GATE c9276ad29 / 4180abc13 with main's FACE wrapper): -GMU_NU=<n> / -GFACE=<f>
# in --vflags override DV2_MU_NU / DV2_FACE; -GSU_LT=1 / -GHD_W130=1 (the kitted slice) reach every FACE through
# tb_qfd_dv2 -> tb_dv2_slice and add XSRCS (hard SU lane tile + its lane sources).
import os  # noqa: E402
MU_NU = int(os.environ.get("DV2_MU_NU", "1"))
FACE = int(os.environ.get("DV2_FACE", "0"))
AM_MUT = int(os.environ.get("DV2_AM_MUT", "0"))
P_RET_AR, P_RET_DD, P_SWI2 = 1001, 1040, 41      # pre-translation codes (TB ports 1 / 40 / 41)
SK = 14


def P_RSS(sl):
    return 2 + 2 * sl


def P_RSN(sl):
    return 3 + 2 * sl


def setid(i):
    return B.pack([(1, 1), (7, 3), (i, 4)])


def cmd_ports2(ar_base, dd_base, ar_en=0, dd_en=0, em_base=0, em_en=0):
    return B.pack([(1, 1), (4, 3), (ar_base, 24), (dd_base, 24), (ar_en, 1), (dd_en, 1), (em_base, 24), (em_en, 1)])


class Ev2(B.Ev):
    """Port translation onto the chain: CMD+sl -> s0.cmd_i at t - 2 sl with dst sl; SWI -> st_up_i of s0."""

    def write(self, path):
        out, used = [], {}
        out.append((2, 0, setid(0)))
        used[2] = 1
        for t, p, v in self.ev:
            if p in (B.P_CMD, B.P_CMD + 1):
                sl = p - B.P_CMD
                ti = t - 2 * sl
                while ti in used:                 # one command enters the chain an edge: arrive earlier
                    ti -= 1
                used[ti] = 1
                out.append((ti, 0, v | (sl << 112)))
            elif p == B.P_SWI:
                out.append((t, P_SWI2, v))
            elif p in (P_RET_AR, P_RET_DD):
                out.append((t, p - 1000, v))
            else:
                out.append((t, p, v))
        with open(path, "w") as f:
            for t, p, v in sorted(out, key=lambda e: (e[0], e[1])):
                f.write(f"{t} {p} {v:x}\n")


def load_vm2(ev, sl, base, vals):
    ev.at(B.P_CMD + sl, cmd_ports2(base, 0, ar_en=1))
    ev.at(B.P_CMD + (1 - sl), cmd_ports2(0, 0, ar_en=0), t=ev.t + 1)
    ev.step(8)
    for w in range(0, len(vals), 16):
        ev.at(P_RET_AR, B.ar_word(vals[w:w + 16]))
        ev.step()
    ev.step(6)


def conv48(w):
    """48-b scalar word -> the 96-b layout dv_bench reads (kind, idx at [87:64], value)."""
    kind = (w >> 44) & 7
    tag, val = (w >> 32) & 0xFFF, w & 0xFFFFFFFF
    k1 = {1: 1, 2: 2, 3: 3, 4: 3, 5: 4}.get(kind, 0)
    idx = val & 0xFFFFFF if kind == 5 else tag
    return (1 << 95) | (k1 << 92) | (idx << 64) | val


VFLAGS: list[str] = []          # S-QSLICE 10-18: --vflags (e.g. -GSU_LT=1 -GHD_W130=1); empty = the original build
# MU-SLICE-GATE 10-19: MU_NU follows -GMU_NU=<n> in --vflags (else DV2_MU_NU), FACE follows -GFACE=<f> (else DV2_FACE);

XSRCS = ["rtl/qwen_dv/qfd_dv_su_lane.sv", "rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_vstream_lane_t.sv", "rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_vstream_sfu_t.sv",
         "rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fpu.sv", "rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_mul_pipe.sv",

def run_sim2(name, ev, work, mut, ncyc, n=2):
    work.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    evf, lgf = work / f"{name}.ev", work / f"{name}.log"
    vtag = "".join(c for c in "_".join(f.lstrip("-+") for f in VFLAGS) if c.isalnum() or c in "_=")
    obj = work / f"obj2_n{n}_nu{MU_NU}_f{FACE}_am{AM_MUT}" / (vtag or "base")
    exe = obj / "Vtb"
    ev.write(evf)
    if not exe.exists():
        cmd = ["verilator", "--cc", "--exe", "--build", "-O2", "-j", "16", "-Wno-fatal", "-Wno-lint", "-Wno-style",
               "-Wno-TIMESCALEMOD", "--x-assign", "0", "--x-initial", "0", "--top-module", "tb_qfd_dv2",
               "--prefix", "Vtb", f"-GMUT={mut}", f"-GN={n}", f"-GMU_NU={MU_NU}", f"-GFACE={FACE}"] + \
              ([f"+define+OT_DV_AMAX_MUT={AM_MUT}"] if AM_MUT else []) + \
              VFLAGS + ["-Mdir", str(obj), str(HERE / "main2.cpp")] + \
              [str(ROOT / s) for s in SRCS2 + (XSRCS if VFLAGS else [])]
        obj.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with open(obj.parent / f"build_{obj.name}.log", "w") as bl:     # kept: a failed build names its error
            r = subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=bl, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        if r.returncode:
            print("    VERILATOR BUILD FAIL:", "".join(open(obj.parent / f"build_{obj.name}.log").readlines()[-15:]))
            raise subprocess.CalledProcessError(r.returncode, cmd[:4])
    subprocess.run([str(exe), f"+EV={evf}", f"+LOG={lgf}", f"+NCYC={ncyc}"], check=True, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    out = {}
    for line in lgf.read_text().split("\n"):
        if line.strip():
            c, nm, h = line.split()
            out.setdefault(nm, []).append((int(c), int(h.replace('x', '0').replace('X', '0').replace('z', '0'), 16)))
    # dv_bench names: root words leaving up = S0SC, slice 1's words leaving down = S1SC; D2D of any slice
    out["S0SC"] = [(c, conv48(w)) for c, w in out.get("S0SU", [])]
    out["S1SC"] = [(c, conv48(w)) for c, w in out.get("S1SD", [])]
    out["S1DD"] = out.get("S0DD", [])
    out["S1E"] = out.get("S1E", [])
    return out


def status_ok2(log):
    bad = []
    for _, ag in log.get("S0AG", [])[:1]:
        if (ag >> 9) & 1:
            bad.append(f"S0AG stn_busy still set at the end ({ag:010b})")
    for k in sorted(n for n in log if n.endswith("ST")):
        v = log[k][0][1]
        if (v >> 69) & 1:
            bad.append(f"{k} fault bits {(v >> 63) & 0x7F:07b} (any,su,vm,stn,sc,stm,port)")
    return bad


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- overridden benches
def bench_a2(work, mut, trials=8, seed=1):
    """As dv_bench (a); the r read back by each slice goes to D2D element 0x10 + slice (one W5 edge port)."""
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    ev = B.Ev()
    X, SSX, RX = 0x0000, 0x3000, 0x3008
    for sl in (0, 1):
        B.load_prog(ev, sl, [
            B.su(nout=16, nin=128, a=X, aso=128, asi=1, red=1, redsq=1, rb=B.W_SC | (16 * sl), rso=1),
            B.su(nout=1, nin=1, a=SSX, ma=B.MA_AIMM, imm1=1.0 / 4096, ad=B.AD_IMM, imm2=EPS, sfu=B.SFU_RSQRT,
                 dst=B.DST_VM, d=B.W_SC | RX),
            B.su(nout=1, nin=1, a=RX, dst=B.DST_VM, d=B.W_D2D | (0x10 + sl)),
        ])
    exp, fused = [], []
    for t in range(trials):
        x = (rng.standard_normal(4096) * rng.choice([0.05, 1.0, 30.0])).astype(F)
        x[rng.integers(0, 4096, 8)] *= F(50)
        x = (x * np.repeat(F(10.0) ** rng.uniform(-1.5, 1.5, 32).astype(F), 128)).astype(F)
        exp.append(B.u32(G.rsqrt(G.add(G.mul(G.reduce_chunked(G.mul(x, x)), F(1.0 / 4096)), EPS))))
        fu = t % 2
        fused.append(fu)
        for sl in (0, 1):
            load_vm2(ev, sl, X, x[2048 * sl:2048 * (sl + 1)])
        ev.at(B.P_CMD + 0, B.cmd_root(1, 32, SSX, fuse=fu, rx=RX, eps=EPS, k=12))
        ev.at(B.P_CMD + 1, B.cmd_root(0, 32, SSX, rx=RX), t=ev.t + 1)
        ev.step(4)
        ev.at(B.P_CMD + 0, B.cmd_su(0)); ev.at(B.P_CMD + 1, B.cmd_su(0), t=ev.t + 1); ev.step(B.gap(256) + 120)
        if not fu:
            ev.at(B.P_CMD + 0, B.cmd_su(1)); ev.step(B.gap(1, 120))
        for sl in (0, 1):
            ev.at(B.P_CMD + sl, B.cmd_su(2)); ev.step(B.gap(1, 60))
    log = run_sim2("a", ev, work, mut, ev.t + 50)
    errs = status_ok2(log)

def pair2(ev, sl, lo_far, lo_near, hi_far, hi_near, t):

            ev.step(gap)
            for w in sorted(x for x in range(nu) if emit_at[x] == i):
                pend.append(w)
            # an emit waits until its user's last results merged (40 edges after the data) and the root finished the
            # previous user's token (30 edges); meanwhile the next ops run
            while pend and ev.t >= done_t[pend[0]] + 40 and ev.t >= last_emit + 30:
                w = pend.pop(0)
                ev.at(B.P_CMD + 1, cmd_amax_u(emit=1, user=w)); ev.at(B.P_CMD + 0, cmd_amax_u(emit=1, user=w), t=ev.t + 3)
                exp.append((rnd, w, int(np.argmax(G.mul(G.add(vals[w], F(0)), F(1.0))))))
                last_emit = ev.t
                ev.step(6)
        while pend:
            w = pend.pop(0)
            ev.step(max(0, done_t[w] + 40 - ev.t, last_emit + 30 - ev.t))
            ev.at(B.P_CMD + 1, cmd_amax_u(emit=1, user=w)); ev.at(B.P_CMD + 0, cmd_amax_u(emit=1, user=w), t=ev.t + 3)
            exp.append((rnd, w, int(np.argmax(G.mul(G.add(vals[w], F(0)), F(1.0))))))
            last_emit = ev.t
            ev.step(6)
        ev.step(40)
    log = run_sim2(f"m_g{gap}_s{seed}", ev, work, mut, ev.t + 20)
    errs = status_ok2(log)
    tok = [w & 0xFFFFFF for _, w in log.get("S0TOK", [])]
    ring = [(w >> 64) & 0xFFFFFF for _, w in log.get("S0SC", []) if (w >> 92) & 7 == 4]
    tok1 = [w & 0xFFFFFF for _, w in log.get("S1TOK", [])]
    # MU-QW-AMIX: token users (status [27:26] at the tok_v edge, TOK word tag[1:0] = raw scalar word [33:32])
    utok = [(w >> 26) & 3 for _, w in log.get("S0TOK", [])]
    utok1 = [(w >> 26) & 3 for _, w in log.get("S1TOK", [])]
    uring = [(w >> 32) & 3 for _, w in log.get("S0SU", []) if (w >> 44) & 7 == 5]
    ok = 0
    for i, (rnd, w, g) in enumerate(exp):
        got = [lst[i] if i < len(lst) else None for lst in (tok, ring, tok1)]
        gu = [lst[i] if i < len(lst) else None for lst in (utok, uring, utok1)]
        if all(x == g for x in got) and (MU_NU == 1 or all(x == w for x in gu)):
            ok += 1
        else:
            errs.append(f"round {rnd} user {w}: root token / broadcast / slice-1 token {got} users {gu}, golden argmax {g}")
    if len(tok) != len(exp):
        errs.append(f"{len(tok)} root tokens for {len(exp)} emits")
    print(f"    bench2 (m): seed {seed} gap {gap} MU_NU {MU_NU} FACE {FACE} AM_MUT {AM_MUT}: {len(exp)} emits, "
          f"{ntie} tie heads, end cycle {ev.t}")
    return ok, len(exp), errs


def bench_o(work, mut, seed=31):
    """MU-ADOPT-SLICE (F-TOK-1 / B2): an STN issued while the previous amax op's station results are still pending is a
    sticky port fault at MU_NU > 1 (it would drop / misattribute them).  Slice 0: STN amax user 1, its 8 data words,
    then DV2_OGAP edges later (default 4: results still streaming) an STN of user 2 (no amax).  Slice 1: the same first
    op, then the second STN 30 edges after the data (legal).  PASS iff slice 0's port fault (status bit 63) is set and
    slice 1's is clear; a second run with both second STNs legal must leave both clear."""
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    og = int(os.environ.get("DV2_OGAP", "4"))
    ok, errs = 0, []
    for case, g0 in (("ovl", og), ("legal", 30)):
        ev = B.Ev()
        v = (rng.standard_normal(256) * 4.0).astype(F)
        for sl in (0, 1):
            ev.at(B.P_CMD + sl, cmd_amax_u(clear=1, user=1), t=ev.t + sl)
        ev.step(4)
        for sl in (0, 1):
            ev.at(B.P_CMD + sl, cmd_stn_u(0, 1, 8, 0, 0, sl * 128, amax=1, user=1), t=ev.t + sl)
        ev.step(4 + SK)
        for k in range(8):
            for sl in (0, 1):
                pair2(ev, sl, v[sl * 128 + 16 * k:sl * 128 + 16 * k + 16], np.zeros(16, dtype=F), None, None, ev.t)
            ev.step()
        t0 = ev.t
        ev.at(B.P_CMD + 0, cmd_stn_u(0, 1, 8, 0, 0, 0x800, amax=0, user=2), t=t0 + g0)
        ev.at(B.P_CMD + 1, cmd_stn_u(0, 1, 8, 0, 0, 0x800, amax=0, user=2), t=t0 + 30 + 1)
        ev.step(80)
        log = run_sim2(f"o_{case}_g{g0}", ev, work, mut, ev.t + 20)
        pf = [(log[f"S{sl}ST"][0][1] >> 63) & 1 for sl in (0, 1)]
        want = [1, 0] if case == "ovl" else [0, 0]
        if pf == want:
            ok += 1
        else:
            errs.append(f"{case} (slice-0 second STN {g0} edges after the data): port fault slice0/slice1 {pf}, want {want}")
    print(f"    bench2 (o): ovl gap {og} MU_NU {MU_NU} FACE {FACE} AM_MUT {AM_MUT}")
    return ok, 2, errs


def bench_n(work, mut, seed=41):
    """MU-QW-AMIX 10-19: the root argmax merge must hold ONE user's candidates (qfd_dv_scalar2 MU_NU > 1 checks it).
    2-slice chain, root = slice 0 (amnb 2).  Users 1 and 2 each run one amax-armed STN chunk on both slices (rows
    sl*512 + {0, 128}..), heads cleared first.  Case 'mixed': slice 1 emits user 1 while the root emits user 2 (one merge,
    two users' candidates), then slice 1 emits user 2 while the root emits user 1.  Every per-slice command is legal for
    qfd_dv_amax_mu (both heads open), so only the root's mixed-merge check can see it: PASS iff the root's sc fault
    (status bit 65) is set, its port fault (63) is clear and slice 1 has no fault.  Case 'legal': the same heads, both
    slices emit user 1, then both user 2: no fault, root / slice-1 tokens = the golden argmax of each user's rows with
    the token user in status [27:26] and in the TOK word tag.  DV2_AM_MUT 7 (no check) must FAIL 'mixed'.  MU_NU > 1."""
    rng = np.random.default_rng(int(os.environ.get("DV2_SEED", seed)))
    users = (1, 2)
    ok, errs = 0, []
    for case in ("mixed", "legal"):
        ev = B.Ev()
        ev.at(B.P_CMD + 0, B.cmd_root(1, 0, 0, amnb=2), t=ev.t)
        ev.at(B.P_CMD + 1, B.cmd_root(0, 0, 0), t=ev.t + 1)
        ev.step(8)
        gold = {}
        for c, u in enumerate(users):
            v = (rng.standard_normal(2 * 128) * 4.0).astype(F)
            v[v == 0] = F(1.0)
            rows = [sl * 512 + c * 128 + j for sl in (0, 1) for j in range(128)]
            vv = G.mul(G.add(v, F(0)), F(1.0))
            gold[u] = rows[int(np.argmax(vv))]
            for sl in (0, 1):
                ev.at(B.P_CMD + sl, cmd_amax_u(clear=1, user=u), t=ev.t + sl)
            ev.step(3)
            for sl in (0, 1):
                ev.at(B.P_CMD + sl, cmd_stn_u(0, 1, 8, 0, 0, sl * 512 + c * 128, amax=1, user=u), t=ev.t + sl)
            ev.step(4 + SK)
            for k in range(8):
                for sl in (0, 1):
                    pair2(ev, sl, v[sl * 128 + 16 * k:sl * 128 + 16 * k + 16], np.zeros(16, dtype=F), None, None, ev.t)
                ev.step()
            ev.step(18)
        ev.step(40)
        pairs = [(1, 2), (2, 1)] if case == "mixed" else [(1, 1), (2, 2)]
        for u1, u0 in pairs:                       # (slice 1's emit user, the root's emit user)
            ev.at(B.P_CMD + 1, cmd_amax_u(emit=1, user=u1)); ev.at(B.P_CMD + 0, cmd_amax_u(emit=1, user=u0), t=ev.t + 3)
            ev.step(40)
        ev.step(20)
        log = run_sim2(f"n_{case}", ev, work, mut, ev.t + 20)
        st0, st1 = log["S0ST"][0][1], log["S1ST"][0][1]
        sc0, pf0, any1 = (st0 >> 65) & 1, (st0 >> 63) & 1, (st1 >> 69) & 1
        if case == "mixed":
            if sc0 == 1 and pf0 == 0 and any1 == 0:
                ok += 1
            else:
                errs.append(f"mixed: root sc fault {sc0} (want 1), root port fault {pf0} (want 0), slice-1 any fault {any1} (want 0)")
            continue
        bad = status_ok2(log)
        tok = [(w & 0xFFFFFF, (w >> 26) & 3) for _, w in log.get("S0TOK", [])]
        tok1 = [(w & 0xFFFFFF, (w >> 26) & 3) for _, w in log.get("S1TOK", [])]
        ring = [((w & 0xFFFFFF), (w >> 32) & 3) for _, w in log.get("S0SU", []) if (w >> 44) & 7 == 5]
        want = [(gold[u], u) for u in users]
        if not bad and tok == want and tok1 == want and ring == want:
            ok += 1
        else:
            errs.append(f"legal: faults {bad}; root {tok} / slice-1 {tok1} / TOK words {ring}, want {want}")
    print(f"    bench2 (n): MU_NU {MU_NU} FACE {FACE} AM_MUT {AM_MUT}")
    return ok, 2, errs


def install():
    B.Ev = Ev2
    B.load_vm = load_vm2
    B.run_sim = run_sim2
    B.status_ok = status_ok2


BENCHES = {"k": bench_k2, "q": bench_q2, "a": bench_a2, "b": B.bench_b, "c": bench_c2, "d": B.bench_d, "e": B.bench_e, "f": bench_f2,
           "g": B.bench_g, "h": bench_h, "i": bench_i, "j": bench_j, "m": bench_m, "o": bench_o, "n": bench_n}


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("benches", nargs="*", default=list("abcdefghij"))
    ap.add_argument("--mut", type=int, default=0)
    ap.add_argument("--work", default="/tmp/qdv_bench2v")
    ap.add_argument("--vflags", default="", help="extra Verilator flags (use a separate --work: objects are cached)")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    VFLAGS[:] = a.vflags.split()
    global MU_NU, FACE
    for f in list(VFLAGS):        # MU_NU / FACE are passed by run_sim2 itself (one -G each)
        if f.startswith("-GMU_NU="):
            MU_NU = int(f.split("=", 1)[1]); VFLAGS.remove(f)
        elif f.startswith("-GFACE="):
            FACE = int(f.split("=", 1)[1]); VFLAGS.remove(f)
    install()
    allpass = True
    for b in a.benches:
        ok, n, errs = BENCHES[b](Path(a.work) / f"m{a.mut}", a.mut)
        verdict = "PASS" if (ok == n and not errs) else "FAIL"
        allpass &= verdict == "PASS"
        print(f"bench2 ({b}) MUT={a.mut}: {verdict} {ok}/{n}")
        for e in errs[:6]:
            print("   ", e)
    sys.exit(0 if allpass else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Q-CTLM calendar bench (rtl/qwen_dv/qfd_dv_cmd_cal.sv inside rtl/qwen_dv/qfd_tt_ctlm_dv.sv), Verilator.

Builds a calendar image (PW0..1023 + DW0..7, the qfd_dv_cmd_cal format), replays it as qfd_sys_face does (tt_pw and
seq_dh on the same edge, one word an edge), starts the four segments (BOOT on the seal, stage 0, stages 1 and 2 = decode
layers, stage 37 = LM head) and compares every issued command / local event with a Python model of the documented
timing (cmd register loaded at S + T_k, T_k = sum of deltas; S = start edge = run event + 1, BOOT S = DW7 + 2; EMB and SEG
one register later).  Also checks dc: the merged next token (ss5 tok_v / tok_idx) -> s_done / ntok two edges later.
--nsl 12 adds the twelve-slice qfd_dv_slice2 row on the cmd / hr chain: every slice must latch id k from the BOOT SETID.

    python3 rtl/test/qwen_dv/tt_ctlm_cal_bench.py [--mut N] [--nsl 12] [--work DIR]
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import random
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parents[2]
BASE = 512                       # entry 0 at PW 512 (8-aligned, below the ME control rows 976..)


def cmdw(go=1, kind=0, f=0, dst=15):
    """slice command word: [0] go, [3:1] kind, [111:4] fields (f << 4), [115:112] dst"""
    return (go & 1) | ((kind & 7) << 1) | ((f & ((1 << 108) - 1)) << 4) | ((dst & 15) << 112)


def setid(i=0):
    return cmdw(1, 7, i & 15, 15)


def build_segments(rng):
    """four segments of (delta, cmd); returns {seg: [(delta, cmd)]}"""
    seg = {}
    seg[3] = [(4, setid(0)), (3, cmdw(1, 4, rng.getrandbits(75), 15)), (2, cmdw(0, 0, 0, 0))]          # BOOT
    s0 = [(5, cmdw(1, 1, 0, 14)),                                   # LOCAL EMB
          (1, cmdw(1, 5, rng.getrandbits(30), 0)),                  # STREAM to W5
          (1, cmdw(1, 1, 7, 15)),                                   # SU pidx 7, all
          (2, cmdw(1, 0, (1 << 2) | (64 << 3) | (0xBEEF << 19), 0)),  # XC: COLL mode 1 words 64 tag
          (4095, cmdw(0, 0, 0, 0)),                                 # NOP spacer
          (9, cmdw(1, 2, rng.getrandbits(46), 3)),                  # STN slice 3
          (1, cmdw(1, 3, rng.getrandbits(99), 0)),                  # ROOT
          (1, cmdw(1, 6, 1, 15))]                                   # AMAX clear
    seg[0] = s0
    s1 = [(4, cmdw(1, 2, rng.getrandbits(46), k % 12)) for k in range(12)]
    s1[0] = (6, s1[0][1])
    s1 += [(1, cmdw(1, 1, 3 + k, 15)) for k in range(9)]                                                   # back-to-back
    s1 += [(3, cmdw(1, 2, 0x155, 14)), (2, cmdw(1, 0, (0 << 2) | (16 << 3) | (77 << 19), 0)), (40, cmdw(1, 1, 300, 15))]
    seg[1] = s1                                                     # [.., LOCAL SEG base 0x155, XC, SU]
    seg[2] = [(4, cmdw(1, 6, 0b10, 15)), (1, cmdw(1, 6, 0b11, 15)), (30, cmdw(1, 0, (1 << 2) | (1 << 3), 0))]
    return seg


def image(seg, mut_meta=False):
    order = [3, 0, 1, 2]
    ents, desc = [], {}
    for s in order:
        while len(ents) % 4:
            ents.append((1, 0))                                     # padding (never fetched: outside the segment)
        desc[s] = (len(ents), len(seg[s]))
        ents += seg[s]
    pw = [0] * 1024
    for i in range(BASE):
        pw[i] = (i * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15) & ((1 << 64) - 1)          # program words (the ME copy and this copy)
    for e, (d, c) in enumerate(ents):
        w = (d << 116) | c
        pw[BASE + 2 * e] = w & ((1 << 64) - 1)
        pw[BASE + 2 * e + 1] = w >> 64
    dw = [0] * 8
    dw[0] = (0x43414C44 << 32) | (BASE << 16) | len(ents)
    for s in range(4):
        f, n = desc[s]
        dw[1 + s] = (f << 16) | n
    return pw, dw, desc


def digest(pw, dw):
    """qkd_program_commit digest over PW0..1023 then DW0..7"""
    m = (1 << 64) - 1
    d = 0x51484F5354505247
    for i, w in enumerate(pw + dw):
        desc, addr = (1, i - 1024) if i >= 1024 else (0, i)
        d = (((d << 7) | (d >> 57)) & m) ^ w ^ ((desc << 10) | addr)
    return d


def model(seg, starts):
    """starts: [(S, seg)] -> expected log lines {(cycle, kind, value)}"""
    exp = []
    for S, s in starts:
        t = 0
        for d, c in seg[s]:
            t += d
            go, kind, dst = c & 1, (c >> 1) & 7, c >> 112
            if not go:
                continue
            if dst == 14:
                if kind == 1:
                    exp.append((S + t + 1, "EMB", None))
                elif kind == 2:
                    exp.append((S + t + 1, "SEG", (c >> 4) & 0xFFF))
            else:
                exp.append((S + t, "CMD", c))
    return exp


def run(work: Path, mut: int, nsl: int):
    rng = random.Random(17)
    seg = build_segments(rng)
    pw, dw, desc = image(seg)
    ev = [(5, 4, 0), (7, 5, digest(pw, dw))]
    c = 10
    for a in range(1024):
        ev.append((c, 0, (a << 64) | pw[a])); c += 1
    for a in range(8):
        ev.append((c, 1, (a << 64) | dw[a])); c += 1
    c_dw7 = c - 1
    boot_s = c_dw7 + 2
    tok, pos = 0x2468A, 77
    run_ev = [(boot_s + 40, 0), (boot_s + 4400, 1), (boot_s + 4600, 2), (boot_s + 4800, 37)]
    starts = [(boot_s, 3)]
    for rc, stg in run_ev:
        ev.append((rc, 2, (1 << 42) | (stg << 36) | (tok << 18) | pos))
        starts.append((rc + 1, {0: 0, 37: 2}.get(stg, 1)))
    tok_c = boot_s + 4900
    ntok = 0x1F00D
    nval = 0x3F8CAFE5                        # Q-DIEPLAN6: the merged value (ss5 tok_val [105:74]) -> dc nval [31:0]
    ev.append((tok_c, 3, (nval << 74) | (1 << 24) | ntok))
    ncyc = tok_c + 20
    exp = model(seg, starts)
    # EMB carries the stage-0 token; SEG the base; the dc s_done / ntok two edges after the ss5 pulse
    exp = [(cy, k, tok if k == "EMB" else v) for cy, k, v in exp]
    work.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    evf, lgf = work / "ev.txt", work / f"log_m{mut}_n{nsl}.txt"
    with open(evf, "w") as f:
        for cy, k, v in sorted(ev, key=lambda e: (e[0], e[1])):
            f.write(f"{cy} {k} {v:x}\n")
    obj = work / f"obj_m{mut}_n{nsl}"
    srcs = [str(ROOT / l.strip()) for l in open(HERE / "tt_ctlm_dv_sources.f") if l.strip()]
    if nsl:
        srcs += [str(ROOT / s) for s in SLICE_SRCS]
    srcs.append(str(HERE / "tb_qfd_tt_ctlm_cal.sv"))
    if not (obj / "Vtb").exists():
        cmd = ["verilator", "--cc", "--exe", "--build", "-O1" if nsl else "-O2", "-j", "8", "-Wno-fatal", "-Wno-lint",
               "-Wno-style", "-Wno-TIMESCALEMOD", "-Wno-WIDTHCONCAT", "--x-assign", "0", "--x-initial", "0",
               "--top-module", "tb_qfd_tt_ctlm_cal", "--prefix", "Vtb", f"-GMUT={mut}", f"-GNSL={nsl}", "-Mdir", str(obj),
               str(HERE / "main2.cpp")] + srcs
        if nsl:
            cmd[cmd.index("--build"):cmd.index("--build")] = ["--output-split", "20000"]
        p = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True)
        if p.returncode:
            print(p.stdout[-3000:], p.stderr[-3000:])
            raise SystemExit("verilator build failed")
    subprocess.run([str(obj / "Vtb"), f"+EV={evf}", f"+LOG={lgf}", f"+NCYC={ncyc}"], cwd=work, check=True,
                   capture_output=True)
    got = []
    sids, cf = {}, None
    ready = fault = commit = None
    errs = []
    dcs = []
    for line in open(lgf):
        p = line.split()
        cy, k = int(p[0]), p[1]
        if k == "CMD":
            got.append((cy, k, int(p[2], 16)))
        elif k == "EMB":
            got.append((cy, k, int(p[2], 16)))
        elif k == "SEG":
            got.append((cy, k, int(p[2], 16)))
        elif k == "DC":
            dcs.append((cy, int(p[2], 16)))
        elif k == "COMMIT":
            commit = cy
        elif k == "SINKF":
            errs.append(f"record-port sink fault at {cy}")
        elif k == "READY":
            ready = cy
        elif k == "FAULT":
            fault = cy
        elif k == "SID":
            sids[int(p[2])] = int(p[3])
        elif k == "CF":
            cf = (int(p[2]), int(p[3]))
    n_extra = 1
    if commit is None:
        errs.append("record-port sink 1 never committed the calendar copy")
    se, sg = set(exp), set(got)
    for e in sorted(se - sg)[:6]:
        errs.append(f"missing {e[1]} at {e[0]} {e[2]:x}" if e[2] is not None else f"missing {e}")
    for g in sorted(sg - se)[:6]:
        errs.append(f"unexpected {g[1]} at {g[0]} {g[2]:x}")
    ok = len(se & sg) + (commit is not None)
    n = len(se) + n_extra
    if ready is None:
        errs.append("calendar image never ready")
    if fault is not None:
        errs.append(f"calendar fault at {fault}")
    # dc: s_done (bit 50), ntok ([49:32]) and nval ([31:0]) two edges after the ss5 tok_v edge
    want = [cy for cy, v in dcs if (v >> 50) & 1 and ((v >> 32) & 0x3FFFF) == ntok and (v & 0xFFFFFFFF) == nval]
    n += 1
    if want and want[0] == tok_c + 2:
        ok += 1
    else:
        errs.append(f"dc s_done/ntok at {want[:1]} want {tok_c + 2}")
    if nsl:
        n += nsl
        for k in range(nsl):
            if sids.get(k) == k:
                ok += 1
            else:
                errs.append(f"slice {k}: id {sids.get(k)}")
    return ok, n, errs
